_about: The App Store screenshot set with a caption and a drawn frame (docs/store/screenshots-designed). One entry per raw capture in docs/store/screenshots, in upload order. `caption` is the whole line; the part between the two markers | | is set in the brand gold. `approved` records the copy approval: every English and Arabic line was approved by the owner on 2026-10-12; Arabic caption 3 was changed by the owner from the draft 'ملخص واضح في ثوانٍ' so that the store promises no time the app cannot keep for large files. No price, plan, upgrade or free wording; no dash; no email.
